name: fwithin.default
title: Subtract theta times the mean. Missing values stay missing.

origin.description: Subtract theta times the mean. Missing values stay missing.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector, a matrix, or a data frame given as a dict of columns.

arguments.name: g
arguments.text: A grouping vector. Levels are sorted.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: Numeric weights for the mean and, for fscale, the standard deviation.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: When true, missing values are skipped. The default is true.

arguments.name: mean
arguments.text: Target mean added after centering. The default is 0.

arguments.name: theta
arguments.text: Fraction of the mean that is removed. The default is 1.

origin.details: Subtract theta times the mean. Missing values stay missing. A time index, TRA, and grouped data frames are not included. A grouped lag reads the row n places back after that group has been seen n times.
origin.value: A numeric vector, matrix, or data frame of the same length.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(collapse))
x <- c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, NA)
g <- c("b", "a", "b", "a", "b", "a")
m <- matrix(c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, 6), nrow = 3)
d <- data.frame(y = c(1, NA, 3), x = c(4, 5, 6))
gm <- c("b", "a", "b")
grab <- function(obj) {
  vals <- if (is.data.frame(obj)) as.numeric(unlist(obj, use.names = FALSE)) else as.numeric(obj)
  ifelse(is.na(vals), "NA", sprintf("%.17g", vals))
}

print(fwithin.default(c(1, 2, 3, 4)))
